candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Overland Flow Pathways
verified_facts: EA states the national overland-flow network was derived from a hydro-enforced 1m bare-earth DTM based on the 2022 LiDAR Composite 1m DTM.
The hydro-enforced DTM was additionally processed with OS Water Network, OS MasterMap features and manual intervention to reduce non-real-world obstructions.
semantic_limits: A hydro-enforced derivative is appropriate for flow modelling but must not replace the unmodified SHA-bound LiDAR DTM raster used for parcel elevation measurements.

candidates.name: Other HM Land Registry plan-related services and guides (practice guide 40, supplement 6)
verified_facts: HM Land Registry states registered land is allocated a unique title number.
The computerised index map is based on the Ordnance Survey map and indexes land in registered titles and pending first-registration applications.
An official index-map search reveals title numbers affecting the searched land and registration type.
semantic_limits: Title-number/index-map context establishes registration identity but does not itself supply exact parcel elevation, surveyed legal boundary coordinates or raster sample provenance.
